function: Continuous-time MIMO channel prediction at arbitrary future time slots from channel estimates at a Chebyshev non-uniform pilot pattern, in high-mobility scenarios (p. 4, 7).
system: Single-antenna UE; BS dual-polarized UPA with 32 antennas (4x4x2), 3GPP urban macro, 3.5 GHz, 60 km/h default velocity; no RIS (p. 3, 11).
method: Supervised deep learning: continuous-time transformer (neural ODE-based attention, high-frequency temporal encoding, element-wise prediction), trained on NMSE with Adam, 300 epochs (p. 7-11).
data_channel: 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa dataset (32 BS antennas, 12 paths, 3.5 GHz) and DeepMIMO ray tracing (Outdoor 1, BS 3, UE rows 501-1400) (p. 10-11, 15).
test_conditions: Train/test split of 3GPP UMa data (12,800/2,560 samples, 60 km/h, 10 dB SNR); also reported at 20-80 km/h, other SNRs and DeepMIMO, training condition not stated (p. 10-15).
baselines: Learned only: GRU, vanilla transformer, neural ODE, latent ODE, ODE-Former (complexity only); uniform and random pilot patterns. No classical predictor compared (p. 13-15).
metrics: NMSE (dB) over prediction time slots, pilot number, MFLOPs and model parameters (p. 10, 13-15).
complexity: Parameters 176.13 M and 395.59 MFLOPs (Table X), O(L2dE) attention complexity; sparse-attention and all-interpolation variants 179.82 and 103.28 MFLOPs (p. 8, 11, 15).
openness: Code on GitHub: https://github.com/sangyl23/Continuous-Time-Transformer (p. 11, 16); DeepMIMO public dataset also used.
q1_support: p. 10: "The channel model of 3GPP TR 38.901 for urban"; the dataset is generated with this model (UMa), and DeepMIMO ray-tracing channels are also used (p. 15).
q2_support: p. 11: "the test data set contain 12, 800 and 2, 560 samples"; test data are a held-out part of the same 3GPP set, and the velocity sweeps (Figs. 6-7) and DeepMIMO (Fig. 9) never state a model trained in one condition and tested in another.
q3_support: p. 14: "outperform GRU [11] and vanilla transformer [12]"; all compared predictors are learned (GRU, transformer, neural ODE, latent ODE), and no AR, Prony, Kalman or outdated-channel baseline appears in Figs. 6-9 or Tables VI-X.
q4_support: p. 15: "Table X compares the model parameters and computational complexity"; Table X lists 176.13 M parameters and 395.59 MFLOPs, and Table VII (p. 11) lists MFLOPs of variants.
q5_support: p. 11: "codes of our simulations have been released at [35]"; reference [35] (p. 16) gives the GitHub link, and the public DeepMIMO dataset is also used (p. 15).
notes: Included, area 2 (channel prediction); BS has 32 antennas so the link is MIMO. q2 set to 0 because no explicit statement: reviewer may confirm whether velocity sweeps or DeepMIMO used a model trained elsewhere. q3 set to 0: uniform and random pilot patterns are variants of the proposal, not classical predictors.
